questions.q: Which OLE DB Source data access mode lets you write a parameterized SQL query directly?
options: Table name or view name variable
SQL command
Table or view
Fast load
questions.explain: SQL command lets you type or build a SQL query, which can include ? parameter placeholders mapped to variables. Fast load is a destination-only concept.

questions.q: What does the OLE DB Destination's "fast load" access mode actually do?
options: Skips the Mappings page entirely
Disables the error output for that destination
Automatically creates indexes on the destination table
Uses SQL Server's bulk-insert mechanism instead of row-by-row INSERT statements
questions.explain: Fast load access modes use bulk insert, which is dramatically faster for large loads than issuing individual INSERT statements per row.

questions.q: What happens if a non-nullable destination column is left unmapped on the Mappings page?
options: Nothing — mapping is purely cosmetic
SSIS silently inserts a zero or empty string
The destination column is automatically dropped
The load fails at run time, because that column requires a value
questions.explain: You don't have to map every destination column, but if an unmapped column doesn't allow nulls, the load fails at run time.

questions.q: Why does the OLE DB Destination not support the "SQL command from variable" access mode that the OLE DB Source has?
options: It does support it, under a different name
Because destinations never use connection managers
SSIS never allows variables on the destination side at all
The destination's access modes are built around loading data efficiently (table/fast-load/SQL command), not the source's broader set of selection options
questions.explain: The OLE DB Destination offers five modes total (Table or view, Table or view - fast load, Table name/view name variable, that variable's fast-load counterpart, and SQL command) — there's no SQL-command-from-variable mode, and no parameter support at all.

questions.q: What can you do on the Connection Manager page of the OLE DB Source Editor before finishing configuration?
options: Directly edit the destination table's schema
Run the entire package
Attach a Data Viewer to the source's output
Click Preview to see up to 200 rows of the extracted data
questions.explain: Preview is available right on the Connection Manager page and shows up to 200 rows — always worth checking before moving on.
